checks: Material master creates bilingual variants, unit conversions and supplier mappings; duplicate code/specification rejected
Identical duplicate submissions replay one durable result
One eligible supplier and multiple materials; exact discount/tax/expense totals; purchase creates no stock
Confirmed purchase follows Imports commitment policy; no cash or physical stock is created
Partial and full receipts are durable, reject over-receipt and keep damaged goods outside usable stock
Receipt failures roll back all lines and stock atomically
Rejected-item return clears quarantine without reducing usable stock or creating inventory value
Supplier return links the original receipt, reopens replacement balance and creates no cash movement
Historical line snapshots survive edits; used units/deletion locked; archive and unused deletion work
Packaging invoice context uses the shared FX engine and original carrying basis
USD→USD payment debits USD 10 on the exact bank account, values KRW 14000 and settles KRW 13000 without changing stock
Advance-only settlement uses the central supplier advance ledger and creates no bank or stock movement
Combined advance and PKR→USD bank payment retain separate non-cash allocation and actual PKR debit
Central supplier profile, payment history, allocations and statement reconcile exactly to the supplier net balance
Existing account/reference duplicate guard applies to packaging purchase payments
Packaging BOM reuses existing product recipes, supports proportional cartons and preserves revisions
Additive migration is retry-safe; stock quantity, movement count, Finance count and foreign keys reconcile
Backend KPI counts and paginated material reads use actual records
Final foreign settlement clears the six-KRW residual through disclosed FX, then passes approval, Finance verification, balanced Accounting posting and supplier reconciliation
Fully prepaid cash purchase receives independently; cash has no supplier bank requirement and payment never changes stock
Partially paid purchase receives all ordered units without forcing the remaining balance to be paid
Safe header edits, stale edit rejection, return-to-draft amendment and unused cancellation preserve Accounting reversal history
Archived or reclassified suppliers cannot be selected for new purchases but historical purchase, payment and supplier profile links remain valid
Backend rejects wrong-unit and unauthenticated Packaging access
Configured L4 purchase approval creates a complete actionable task, blocks premature receiving and executes once after independent approval
